newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK interbank rates, govt paper yields slightly down.
newsitem.headline: HK interbank rates, govt paper yields slightly down.

text.p: Hong Kong interbank market rates and government paper yields were down slightly in thin trade on Tuesday, dealers said.
Overnight cash stood at 5-7/16 1/2 percent against 5-9/16 1/2 at Monday's midsession. Three-month money remained unchanged at 5-9/16 1/2 percent.

"Although the rate is slightly lower for short-dated money, it remains at a high level because of eleven IPOs (initial public offerings of stock) expected this month," a dealer with an European bank said.
